titleEn: All Elements in Two Binary Search Trees
title: 两棵二叉搜索树中的所有元素
summary: 返回两棵二叉搜索树中全部元素组成的升序列表。
insight: 每棵 BST 的中序遍历都是非递减序列；分别收集两个序列后按归并排序的合并步骤线性生成最终列表。
pitfalls: 归并尾部剩余元素不能遗漏

solutions.title: 双中序序列归并
solutions.idea: 利用 BST 中序有序性把排序降为线性归并。
steps: 中序遍历 root1、root2 得 first、second
i=j=0，比较两序列当前值，将较小者加入答案并推进
一序列耗尽后追加另一序列剩余，返回

code.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> getAllElements(TreeNode root1,TreeNode root2){List<Integer> first=new ArrayList<>(),second=new ArrayList<>(),answer=new ArrayList<>();inorder(root1,first);inorder(root2,second);int i=0,j=0;while(i<first.size()||j<second.size())if(j==second.size()||i<first.size()&&first.get(i)<=second.get(j))answer.add(first.get(i++));else answer.add(second.get(j++));return answer;}private void inorder(TreeNode node,List<Integer> values){if(node==null)return;inorder(node.left,values);values.add(node.val);inorder(node.right,values);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun getAllElements(root1:TreeNode?,root2:TreeNode?):List<Int>{val first=mutableListOf<Int>();val second=mutableListOf<Int>();fun inorder(node:TreeNode?,values:MutableList<Int>){node?:return;inorder(node.left,values);values.add(node.`val`);inorder(node.right,values)};inorder(root1,first);inorder(root2,second);val answer=mutableListOf<Int>();var i=0;var j=0;while(i<first.size||j<second.size)if(j==second.size||i<first.size&&first[i]<=second[j])answer.add(first[i++])else answer.add(second[j++]);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { void inorder(TreeNode* node,vector<int>& values){if(!node)return;inorder(node->left,values);values.push_back(node->val);inorder(node->right,values);}public:vector<int> getAllElements(TreeNode* root1,TreeNode* root2){vector<int> first,second,answer;inorder(root1,first);inorder(root2,second);int i=0,j=0;while(i<(int)first.size()||j<(int)second.size())if(j==(int)second.size()||(i<(int)first.size()&&first[i]<=second[j]))answer.push_back(first[i++]);else answer.push_back(second[j++]);return answer;} };
